description: OmniAccelerANT's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ContainerHub's repository root (default.json); the one line below is the whole adoption.

The part this repo could not get any other way is the git-submodules manager, which Renovate DISABLES by default: all four gitlinks here (ANThology, ContainerHub, OxidANT, AccelerANTgine) have been unwatched since the day they were added, and three of them are owned and fast-moving. Each has a `branch =` entry in .gitmodules, which is what the manager needs to know what tip to bump towards.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ContainerHub` from ContainerHub's DEFAULT BRANCH, so a preset change reaches this repo only after it is merged there - and this file is inert until the Renovate GitHub App is actually installed on this repository. No bot has ever landed a commit here.
.github/dependabot.yml is deliberately still present; see the comment at its top for the hand-over condition.
